title: Just-in-Time Observability Access Broker & Tiered Pruning Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a Just-in-Time (JIT) Access Broker and accompanying tiered pruning/playbook for observability pipelines. The broker issues time-limited, auditable access to full-resolution traces/logs/metrics (for debugging or security investigations) while the default retention enforces tenant-scoped, low-resolution summarization. Goals: minimize live PII surface, make ad-hoc full-data access requestable with approvals and signed tokens, and automate pruning to enforce cost and privacy SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: JIT broker endpoint implemented that returns signed short-lived access tokens for trace/log retrieval
Audit trail recorded for every JIT grant: requestor, approver (if required), justification, time window
Automated pruning pipeline enforces tiered retention windows (hot full-resolution, warm partial/aggregate, cold anonymized) per tenant
RBAC integration: broker honors identity provider group mappings and supports least-privilege approval flows
Dashboard visible in Console: number of JIT grants, average grant duration, denied requests, and post-grant data accesses
Performance: token issuance latency < 200ms P95 and retrieval flow does not add >5% overhead to existing query latency
technical_design: Broker as a thin service in control plane that validates identity, checks policy engine, and mints short-lived signed URLs (S3/columnstore) or presigned query tokens
Policy engine rules: tenant defaults, SLA tier overrides, incident role overrides (on-call), and manual escalation thresholds
Data plane storage split: hot (full traces, default 7 days), warm (aggregated traces, 30 days), cold (pseudonymized exports, 365 days)
Pruning worker reads retention manifest and enforces deletions/transformations with idempotent operations and write-ahead markers
Audit log format: immutable append-only record with fields [grant_id, principal, scope, reason, approver, token_id, issued_at, expires_at, resource_path], stored in encrypted audit log topic
Integration points: Console (UI request flow), IAM (SCIM group sync), Alerting (pager/Slack for emergency exempt grants), Observability pipelines (indexer to mark segments eligible for pruning)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal alpha): expose JIT broker for SRE and security with manual approval set to `auto-approve` for on-call groups
Phase 2 (beta): open to select platform customers behind feature flag, enable approval requirement for non-SRE roles
Phase 3 (GA): default enforcement for all tenants with migration tool to backfill aggregated artifacts and prune eligible full-resolution shards
Fallbacks: automatic fallback to anonymized export if storage backend denies access; removal of JIT endpoints via feature flag in emergency
